title: Register with a GP in Leiden

shortSummary.text: Find a nearby practice, confirm acceptance and ask about the documents and coverage you need.

whoThisIsFor.text: Students settling in Leiden who need a regular huisarts.

whenYouNeedIt.text: Arrange this before you need routine care, where possible.

jurisdiction.note: National rules; local starting points for Leiden students.

prerequisites.text: Arrange this before you need routine care, where possible.

requiredDocuments.text: ID and insurance evidence; confirm the practice’s own requirements rather than sending medical records to YouNew.

estimatedTime.note: Acceptance and appointment availability must be confirmed by the practice.

estimatedCost.note: Under Dutch basic insurance, a GP visit is outside the mandatory deductible; tests or medicines may be different. Check foreign-policy reimbursement separately.

numberedSteps.title: Find nearby practices
numberedSteps.body: Use the university’s doctor page as a starting point, then contact the practice directly about current acceptance.

numberedSteps.title: Check requirements
numberedSteps.body: Prepare ID and proof of insurance. Ask about any other registration data and the payment process for your cover.

numberedSteps.title: Confirm and transfer
numberedSteps.body: After acceptance, inform your previous GP and request transfer of the medical record to the new practice.

numberedSteps.title: If practices are full
numberedSteps.body: Ask your insurer for help finding a GP. Thuisarts also lists Zorgbelang for concerns about refusal.

warnings.text: Do not postpone urgent care while waiting for routine registration; use the appropriate healthcare contact.

commonMistakes.text: Do not assume that every test or medicine is covered like the GP consultation.

tips.text: Keep the practice’s contact instructions available and update them after moving.

faqs.question: Everyone says no?
faqs.answer: Ask the insurer to help or mediate.

faqs.question: Only foreign insurance?
faqs.answer: Ask the practice and insurer about payment and reimbursement before a routine appointment.

faqs.question: Previous medical records?
faqs.answer: Ask the old practice to transfer the record securely to the new GP.

emergencyInformation.text: This guide cannot decide your personal case. Use the responsible institution for help.

sections.title: Check before acting
sections.body: Distance and capacity can limit your choice. A listed practice is not a promise of a place.

nextActions.text: Keep the practice’s contact instructions available and update them after moving.
